Off: follows the last half minute of fixes. Best for GPS with turns and speed changes. On: follows the trend over about an hour. Best for noisy positions or long, steady travel.
Set the clock to the target now? It may jump, including backwards.

The widget redraws every second, which wakes the phone about 3,600 times an hour. Expect noticeably higher battery use while a seconds widget is on the home screen. Minutes is the default and is much lighter. Keep it on only if you need the second hand on the widget.
maximum ping frequency - one ping per %1$d s
Frequent location checks use more battery. Pinging every 10 s or faster can noticeably increase battery use while moving. Still, the phone checks once a minute, whatever this setting.
Enter a whole number from 10 to 10000

Tempus Fugit shows longitude time: UTC plus 4 minutes for every degree east, with no daylight saving time.

Location is used only on this phone and only while the app is open. The app has no network access. Only the time zone name and the clock offset are stored, never coordinates.
